_comment: Per-string context pushed to Crowdin by `npm run i18n:context`. One line per key saying where the string appears and what constrains it — the facts a translator cannot get from the English alone. Written when the string is, by whoever ran /wording. Keys mirror en.json.
title: Title of the small dialog where a player enters a clearance code to join an investigation already under way that they have no access to yet. One line; the heading is short on purpose because the legend explains.
legend: Sits above the code field and is its only label — there is no separate field label. Two or three lines. "Clearance" means security access (Russian "допуск", German "Freigabe"), not customs clearance or a sale; use the same term as the main menu's join_game. The active member is whoever is already in the investigation.
format_hint: Small red text under the code field when what was entered, or what arrived in a link, is not a well-formed code, so nothing was sent. A code is exactly six letters and digits. One line.
submit: Primary button that sends the code. One or two words.
cancel: Closes the dialog. Same wording as the credentials form's dismiss button.
errors.rejected: Shown when the code is refused. Deliberately the same for an unknown, expired or no-longer-valid code — do not add anything that hints which.
errors.too_many_attempts: Shown after too many codes in a short time (five in five minutes). Must read clearly different from errors.rejected.
errors.generic: Server or network failure, not the code's fault. Same wording as the credentials form's generic error.
